source_conflicts.finding: Docs say more-info; runtime overrides tap to toggle. Follow runtime for behavioral parity.
Docs default [armed_home,armed_away] is getStubConfig output, not unconditional runtime default. setConfig without states has no configured arm controls.
Docs generic defaults none; runtime entity present injects card more-info and domain-dependent icon toggle.
Docs say only first inline feature; v5.2.3 runtime renders remaining below on HA >=2026.9.
entity_id documented and runtime used, but omitted in TS config struct/editor; alignment supported by source/editor but absent docs table.
Docs call name a string; source supports entity/device/area/floor/text NameItem or arrays.
Source includes on_off command, omitted docs table list.
Many docs say default more-info; base setConfig only assigns tap/hold. Double-tap config absent and action-handler only enables detection when configured. Preserve runtime and test in HA.
Legacy Template exists as 19th card import but excluded from required18; new Template still migrates legacy-shaped config.
Current conditional-chip extends actual hui-conditional-base, so old checkConditionsMet helper is not complete condition support.
Chips and Title have no getGridOptions implementation in v5.2.3. Do not falsely attribute 6x1 default method to upstream.
